key.name: compact-view-enabled
key.description: Whether the Compact List view is active in Nautilus windows.

key.name: max-column-width-chars
key.description: Maximum filename character length before smart filename shortening is applied.

key.name: shortening-mode
key.description: Shortening strategy for long filenames: 'smart-suffix' (preserves numeric/date endings) or 'middle' (standard middle ellipsis).

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Icon size in pixels for Compact List view (16, 32, or 64).
